seo.description: Who SSV Potsdamer Straße is, what it does and how residents are represented.

blocks.title: Who we are
blocks.intro: The SSV is the student self-government of the Potsdamer Straße residence – by residents, for residents.

blocks.heading: What is the SSV?
blocks.body: The student self-government (SSV) is the elected representation of the residents of the Potsdamer Straße residence. It gathers concerns from the house, raises them with the residence management and organises community activities. All residents can contribute ideas, take part in open meetings and get involved.

cards.title: Being your contact
cards.text: We are the first point of contact for questions, problems and ideas about living here.

cards.title: Looking after rooms
cards.text: We take care of the common rooms and their equipment.

cards.title: Celebrating
cards.text: We organise events for all residents.

blocks.heading: How you are represented
blocks.body:
The SSV takes up the concerns of residents and raises them in talks with the residence management. Decisions and current topics are discussed in open meetings. Anyone who lives in the residence can ask questions, make suggestions and take part in joint projects.

* Regular, open meetings
* General assembly for all residents

blocks.heading: The SSV team
blocks.intro: We are residents who volunteer to make living together in the residence better. We only publish names and photos with the consent of the person concerned.

blocks.heading: Want to join?
blocks.text: Come to an open meeting or write to us.
